title: A Wandering Black Hole Lit Up Like 10 Billion Suns

scenes.text: A black hole outshone its whole galaxy while eating a star.
NASA's Swift telescope watched the flare.
It shone with the light of about ten billion suns.
The black hole is about a million times the mass of our Sun.
It sits on the outskirts of its galaxy, over thirty thousand light-years from the center.
That is odd, because events like this were only ever seen in galaxy cores.
A star got too close and was torn apart. The flash outshone a galaxy.

description:
A black hole outshone its whole galaxy while eating a star.
NASA's Swift saw a wandering black hole far from its galaxy's center tear apart a star, briefly shining with the light of about 10 billion suns in ultraviolet.
What would you do if one were near us?
first_comment: Bonus: it is about 750 million light-years away, so we are seeing it long after it happened. How far away would you want a black hole to be?
